product.tagline: 在本机安全管理远程目录、文件操作与终端入口。
product.description: 连接 SFTP、SCP、FTP、FTPS 和 WebDAV，集中浏览本地与远端文件、执行传输与常见操作，并通过稳定 CLI 支持脚本和 AI Agent。
nonGoals: 替代专业终端、SSH 客户端或云盘同步服务
把远程凭据写入仓库、日志或机器可读诊断
在没有明确目标和确认的情况下执行批量删除或覆盖

capabilities.title: 连接与收藏
capabilities.body: 管理最近连接、收藏连接与同一主机下的常用目录，减少重复输入和误选目标。

capabilities.title: 双栏文件工作台
capabilities.body: 同时浏览本地和远端目录，执行新建、重命名、复制、移动、删除、权限与文本预览。

capabilities.title: 传输与冲突检查
capabilities.body: 上传、下载前显示目标和冲突状态，帮助用户在覆盖文件前核对实际范围。

capabilities.title: 终端与补全
capabilities.body: 提供本地命令入口、基础远端命令入口，以及按目标终端组织的历史和片段补全。

capabilities.title: Agent CLI
capabilities.body: 通过 info、capabilities、browse 和 connections 命令输出稳定 JSON，方便脚本和 Agent 调用。

workflow.label: 连接
workflow.title: 选择协议与目标目录
workflow.body: 从收藏或最近连接进入，并确认主机、协议和起始目录。

workflow.label: 检查
workflow.title: 核对本地与远端路径
workflow.body: 在双栏视图确认当前路径、文件名和操作目标，再选择文件动作。

workflow.label: 执行
workflow.title: 传输前确认冲突
workflow.body: 上传、下载和删除前查看冲突、权限及目标信息，再执行动作。

workflow.label: 自动化
workflow.title: 用 JSON CLI 复用流程
workflow.body: 先用 capabilities 发现能力，再用 browse 或 connections 命令完成可审计的脚本流程。

boundary.title: 连接信息可见，凭据留在本机
boundary.body: rTerm 是远程目录工作台，不是云盘或无人值守同步服务。它只操作用户明确选择的路径，连接凭据与 SSH 密钥由本机安全存储管理，CLI 输出不应包含秘密内容。

website.releaseSummary: 首个公开预览版覆盖多协议远程目录、双栏浏览、文件操作、传输冲突检查、终端入口和稳定 JSON CLI。

product.tagline: Manage remote directories, file actions, and terminal entry points locally.
product.description: Connect to SFTP, SCP, FTP, FTPS, and WebDAV, browse local and remote files, perform transfers, and expose a stable CLI for scripts and AI agents.
nonGoals: Replace a full terminal, SSH client, or cloud sync service
Write remote credentials into repositories, logs, or diagnostics
Run bulk deletion or overwrite without a visible target and confirmation

capabilities.title: Connections and favorites
capabilities.body: Keep recent connections, favorites, and common directories for each host in one local workspace.

capabilities.title: Two-pane file workbench
capabilities.body: Browse local and remote directories together and run common file actions with the target in view.

capabilities.title: Transfers with conflict checks
capabilities.body: Review destination and conflicts before uploading or downloading files.

capabilities.title: Terminal and completion
capabilities.body: Use local and basic remote command entry points with history and target-terminal completion.

capabilities.title: Agent CLI
capabilities.body: Discover capabilities and run browse or connection checks through stable JSON commands.

workflow.label: Connect
workflow.title: Choose a protocol and target
workflow.body: Open a favorite or recent connection and confirm the host, protocol, and starting directory.

workflow.label: Inspect
workflow.title: Verify local and remote paths
workflow.body: Check both panes, filenames, and the intended target before running a file action.

workflow.label: Execute
workflow.title: Review transfer conflicts
workflow.body: Inspect conflicts, permissions, and destination details before upload, download, or deletion.

workflow.label: Automate
workflow.title: Reuse the flow through JSON CLI
workflow.body: Discover capabilities first, then use browse or connection commands in scripts and agents.

boundary.title: Connection state is visible; secrets stay local
boundary.body: rTerm is a remote directory workbench, not a cloud sync service. It operates on explicitly selected paths, while credentials and SSH keys remain in local secure storage and CLI output avoids secrets.

website.releaseSummary: The first public preview covers multi-protocol remote directories, two-pane browsing, file actions, transfer conflict checks, terminal entry, and a stable JSON CLI.
